name: Bulgarian
script: Cyrillic (Bulgarian alphabet, 30 letters); left to right
basis: Beginner Bulgarian course content list (University of Craiova), put into teaching order by dependency
src: University of Craiova (ucv.ro), Bulgarian language course description (PDF): unordered lists of beginner topics and grammar (съм, pronouns, question words, gender and agreement, definite article, present, aorist, future, има / няма, reflexive verbs, comparison, prepositions); no textbook named
American University in Bulgaria, Introduction to Bulgarian Language and Culture I course page: overview only (Cyrillic alphabet first), no lesson order
note: No ordered syllabus or textbook table of contents was opened for Bulgarian. The topics and grammar come from the Craiova list; their order, the three script lessons, the да-clause lesson and all titles are common course practice and my own judgment. Prices use the euro, which Bulgaria adopted on 1 January 2026.
hardest: Cyrillic, including letters that look English but sound different (в, н, р, с, у, х)
The definite article on the end of the word: -ът / -а, -та, -то, -те
No infinitive: 'I want to go' is искам да отида
Aspect pairs and the aorist past tense

items: Cyrillic I: familiar letters (а, е, к, м, о, т) and false friends (в, н, р, с, у, х)
Cyrillic II: new letters (б, г, д, ж, з, и, й, л, п, ф, ц, ч, ш, щ)
Cyrillic III: ъ, ь, ю, я and reading words
Free stress and the vowel ъ
Greetings: здравей, здравейте, добър ден; ти and вие
съм: аз съм, ти си, той е… and Това е…
Introducing yourself: Казвам се…, Откъде сте?
Gender and plural: град, жена, село; градове
Adjectives that agree: нов, нова, ново, нови
Questions with ли and question words: кой, какво, къде, кога
Numbers and prices: Колко струва? евро
Present tense, three conjugations: чета, говоря, имам
има and няма: there is, have, there isn't
Ordering food: Искам…, Може ли…? Сметката, моля
да + verb instead of 'to': искам да, мога да, трябва да
Family and short possessives: майка ми, брат ми
Time and days: Колко е часът? в понеделник
Reflexive verbs and daily routine: събуждам се, обличам се
Places and movement: в, на, от, до
Directions and transport: наляво, надясно, направо
Future: ще + verb, and няма да
